title: Write a customer handoff guide
instructions: Write a short Markdown guide for an engineer receiving this local prototype. Use only the facts in context. Include how to start, the expected output, how to stop, and the current limits. Do not claim a public release or customer adoption.

context.name: Example handoff prototype
context.output: A release-notes.md file and signed receipt/audit exports
context.stop: The demo stops its host after the handoff; Ctrl+C cancels a manual run
limits: The starter demo uses deterministic adapters without model inference
Runtime permissions apply to its APIs and do not sandbox outside tools
A signed receipt does not prove the result is true

acceptanceCriteria: Include the exact start command npm run demo
Describe the release-notes.md output and signed evidence exports
Explain the stop behavior and all three supplied limits; describe API permissions without calling the runtime a process sandbox
Keep the guide under 250 words and invent no release or adoption claims
